summary: Tested new inline-editing feature end-to-end (Facilities/CC/WCDL/GML). Wrote pytest suite covering PUT /facilities/{id}, PUT /cc-transactions/{id}, PUT /wcdl-loans/{id} incl. WCDL+GML parametrization and both validation branches - all 4 test classes pass. Ran Playwright UI flow: created 3 facilities + 2 CC txs + 1 WCDL loan + 1 GML loan via API, clicked edit pencil on each surface, verified all editable inputs render with expected data-testids (bank/name/limit/daycount/start/maturity/status for facilities; date/value-date/debit/credit/bank-interest for CC; loan/drawdown/amount/repayment/bank-interest for WCDL/GML), saved edits and confirmed values persist and 'Our interest' recalculates (CC interest went from ₹2,219→₹2,638 after debit change 200k→350k). Verified cancel reverts. Verified CC opening row does NOT render an edit button (only real tx rows do). Validation paths: attempted debit=0+credit=0 (CC) and repayment<drawdown (WCDL) - row data NOT persisted (backend enforces via 400). All UITEST facilities cleaned up; GET /api/facilities returns [] at finish.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: CCWorking.jsx line 26 initialises editForm.bank_interest from r.bank (engine-computed bank interest column) rather than the raw stored bank_interest. When the user opens edit on a row that has no user-set bank_interest, the field pre-fills with the calculated bank amount (nonzero based on outstanding*rate). If the user then hits Save without clearing it, that computed value will get persisted as user-entered bank_interest. Consider using r.bank_interest instead. Not a blocker - purely a UX polish item.
Minor: React hydration warning noted in console - <span> inside <option> in the facility select dropdown (from x-ve-dynamic instrumentation). Cosmetic dev-time warning, not a functional bug.
